question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Competent
solution:
The correct answer is "**Capable**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **Competent means having the necessary ability, knowledge, or skill to do something successfully.**(सक्षम)

 
 
• ​Example: She is a competent manager and can handle any situation efficiently.
 
 
 
• **​Capable is a synonym of competent, meaning having the ability, power, or quality to do something.**(काबिल)
 
 
• ​Example: A capable doctor like her are very rare nowadays.
 
 
 
 
 
• ​​Thus, it is clear that the word "capable" is the synonym of the word "competent."

​Hence, **the correct answer is option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2 (Overqualified) means having more qualifications, skills, or experience than is required for a particular job.(अतियोग्य)
 
• Option 3 (Unfit) means not having the necessary qualities or abilities for a particular task or job.(अयोग्य)
 
• Option 4 (Unskilled) means lacking the necessary skills or training for a particular job or activity.(अकुशल)
